episodes.title: What is Money?
episodes.summary: Hamm attempts to give Forky a lesson on how the US monetary system works.

episodes.title: What is a Friend?
episodes.summary: Forky turns to an inanimate object, a ceramic mug, to answer his deep questions about friendship.

episodes.title: What is Art?
episodes.summary: Forky and Mr. Pricklepants engage in acting banter in an effort to define what art is.

episodes.title: What is Time?
episodes.summary: Rex uses the age of real dinosaurs as an example to give Forky an understanding of the concept of time.

episodes.title: What is Love?
episodes.summary: Forky attempts to understand the concept of love from Bonnie's elder toys who believe they've been there, done that.

episodes.title: What is a Computer?
episodes.summary: Trixie explains to Forky what a computer does as they experience the common stresses of technology.

episodes.title: What is a Leader?
episodes.summary: Dolly teaches Forky about the qualities of a good leader, and Forky puts those qualities to the test!

episodes.title: What is a Pet?
episodes.summary: Forky meets Rib Tickles and finds her charming and pleasant, only to be schooled by Rib on the dangers of law enforcement

episodes.title: What is Cheese?
episodes.summary: Buttercup, annoyed with all of Forky's questions, speed teaches everything there is.

episodes.title: What is Reading?
episodes.summary: The energetic Peas-n-a-Pod siblings teach Forky about reading and how it is done, with a little help from Mr. Spell.
